Auto-optimize for OpenSearch provides the following beneﬁts:
• Automated parameter tuning - Eliminates manual experimentation with algorithm (HNSW),
quantization, rescoring and engine parameters, saving time and reducing the learning curve for
vector search optimization.
Auto-optimize
1591
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
• Optimize search speed - By default, OpenSearch is conﬁgured for in-memory performance.
Auto-optimize discovers favorable trade-oﬀs that improve search quality and cost savings while
maintaining acceptable search speed.
• Cost optimization - Reduces cost by ﬁnding options to reduce your index memory requirements
while minimizing search quality and speed trade-oﬀs.
• Optimize search quality - Potentially deliver higher recall than default settings, or discover
favorable trade-oﬀs that deliver signiﬁcant cost savings with minimal recall loss.
Auto-optimize works alongside other OpenSearch features such as GPU-acceleration for vector
indexing to provide comprehensive performance optimization for vector search workloads.
